## ObjectReferenceData type

Data form of a single-object reference, of either form.

**Signature:**

```typescript
type ObjectReferenceData<Id = unknown, R extends string = string> =
  | IdentityReferenceData<Id, R>
  | SelectorReferenceData<R>
```

**References:** [IdentityReferenceData](./contracts.identityreferencedata.md)<!-- -->, [SelectorReferenceData](./contracts.selectorreferencedata.md)

## Remarks

This is what a typed single-object input position accepts: a caller can build either form, and a bound reference to the same resource (an [ObjectReferenceVariant](./contracts.objectreferencevariant.md)<!-- -->) is assignable to it. The resource key is a literal type at a typed position, so a reference to another resource is not.
